program.lowered_gooo_source:
package gooo_workspace
namespace gooo_workspace

entity Report id "gooo://tools/report/v1" fields {
    field state id "gooo://tools/report/state" type string required one
    field next_operation id "gooo://tools/report/next-operation" type string required one
    field message id "gooo://tools/report/message" type string required one
}
entity Text id "gooo://tools/report/text"
entity DocumentationObservation id "gooo://domain-tools/documentation-observation" fields {
    field declared id "gooo://domain-tools/documentation/declared" type integer required one
    field documented id "gooo://domain-tools/documentation/documented" type integer required one
    field implemented id "gooo://domain-tools/documentation/implemented" type integer required one
    field stale id "gooo://domain-tools/documentation/stale" type boolean required one
}
activity GoooPackage0ActivityAssess(DocumentationObservation) -> Report computes "if input.declared < 0 || input.documented < 0 || input.implemented < 0 || input.documented > input.declared || input.implemented > input.declared {\n    return Report{state: \"FAIL_CLOSED\", next_operation: \"RECONCILE_COUNTS\", message: \"관측 수치를 확인하세요.\"}\n}\nif input.declared == 0 {\n    return Report{state: \"UNKNOWN\", next_operation: \"DECLARE_FEATURES\", message: \"기능 목록을 선언하세요.\"}\n}\nif input.stale {\n    return Report{state: \"PROGRESS\", next_operation: \"UPDATE_EXAMPLES\", message: \"구현과 예제를 다시 맞추세요.\"}\n}\nif input.implemented < input.declared {\n    return Report{state: \"PROGRESS\", next_operation: \"IMPLEMENT_DECLARATIONS\", message: \"선언한 기능의 구현이 남았습니다.\"}\n}\nif input.documented == input.declared {\n    return Report{state: \"PASS\", next_operation: \"CHECK_NEW_FEATURES\", message: \"선언한 기능과 예제가 일치합니다.\"}\n}\nlet result = Report{state: \"\", next_operation: \"\", message: \"\"}\nresult.state = \"UNKNOWN\"\nresult.next_operation = \"DOCUMENT_MISSING\"\nresult.message = \"모든 예제를 작성했습니다.\"\nreturn result" assembling {
    choice "partial-state" field_update at "0" alternative "\"PROGRESS\"" intent "미작성 예제를 부분 충족으로 기록한다. Use PROGRESS for missing examples."
    choice "keep-action" field_update at "1" alternative "\"REWRITE_COMPILER\"" intent "기존 문서 작성 동작을 유지한다. Keep the original DOCUMENT_MISSING action."
    choice "explanation" field_update at "2" alternative "\"예제가 없는 기능이 남았습니다.\"" intent "문서가 필요한 기능을 설명한다. Explain the missing feature examples."
    value_case "[{\"declared\":2,\"documented\":1,\"implemented\":2,\"stale\":false}]" -> "{\"message\":\"예제가 없는 기능이 남았습니다.\",\"next_operation\":\"DOCUMENT_MISSING\",\"state\":\"PROGRESS\"}"
    value_case "[{\"declared\":2,\"documented\":2,\"implemented\":2,\"stale\":false}]" -> "{\"message\":\"선언한 기능과 예제가 일치합니다.\",\"next_operation\":\"CHECK_NEW_FEATURES\",\"state\":\"PASS\"}"
    value_case "[{\"declared\":0,\"documented\":0,\"implemented\":0,\"stale\":false}]" -> "{\"message\":\"기능 목록을 선언하세요.\",\"next_operation\":\"DECLARE_FEATURES\",\"state\":\"UNKNOWN\"}"
    attempts "8"
}
activity GoooPackage1ActivityRender(Report) -> Text computes "return input.state + \" | \" + input.next_operation + \" | \" + input.message"
bind GoooPackage0ActivityAssess.result -> GoooPackage1ActivityRender.input
